Real neighbourhood widely documented in travel press; heritage walk itineraries confirm landmarks (Tobacco Square, Sao Tome Chapel, Chapel of St Sebastian). Coordinates are an approximate quarter centroid, not a point-verified location.
Coordinates (15.49621, 73.830781) from a business directory listing; history and Inquisition crucifix detail from Lonely Planet; feast date (20 Jan) from Evendo.
Coordinates (15.450608, 73.803005) from a business directory listing; described as one of Goa's most iconic scenic spots in published reviews.
Coordinates 15.48306, 73.80722 from Wikipedia (Miramar, Goa); history details from the same article.

Coordinates (15.500821, 73.829987) and official site http://museum.goa.gov.in/ from directory listing; hours and free entry from LBB (9:45–1:15 & 2:00–5:30 Mon–Fri); conflicting published hours exist (10:00–17:30 / 9:30–17:30, closed weekends or Fridays), so check before visiting.
Departure point and cruise formats from Trawell and cruisesingoa.com; jetty coordinates are approximate (Patto/Panaji riverfront), not point-verified.

Hours and fees from Tripoto/Travelogy India/Lonely Planet (fee amounts conflict slightly: Rs. 10 vs Rs. 20 Indians; note as approximate). Coordinates are approximate for the Chorao island sanctuary area near the ferry landing, not point-verified.
Coordinates 15.477427, 73.809075 from Wikipedia; hours/fees conflict across published listings (HOHO Goa: 10:30–18:30, Rs. 10; PlaceApp: 9:30–18:00, Rs. 20), so treat as approximate.

Coordinates (15.494236, 73.817665) and hours from a business directory listing; history (Charles Correa, est. Feb 1970) from Trek Zone. Official website not independently fetch-verified, so treat URL with caution.
Real garden documented in church descriptions (southeast of the church hill). Coordinates approximate relative to the church; not point-verified.
Coordinates (15.490435, 73.828336) from a directory listing, consistent with Atlas Obscura (15.490413, 73.828328); 1931-1934 construction and viewpoint description from Atlas Obscura.
Coordinates (15.496774, 73.821448) and hours from a business directory listing. Official website not fetch-verified, so treat URL with caution.
Coordinates 15.50000, 73.82611 from Wikipedia (Azad Maidan public square); history details from the same article.
Real, long-established market in central Panaji. Coordinates approximate for the central market area; not point-verified. Hours/prices not from published sources.
Real, well-documented riverfront walk (also called Campal promenade). Coordinates approximate along D.B. Bandodkar Marg; not point-verified.
Coordinates (15.462806, 73.806006) and hours from a business directory listing. Secondary church; included to cover Caranzalem.
Real landmark bridge; coordinates approximate for the Panaji-side span, not point-verified. Visible from Maruti Temple per Atlas Obscura.

Real and major Panaji attraction, referenced in Mandovi cruise literature (Trawell notes casino ships accessible from Panaji Jetty). Coordinates approximate for the Panaji jetty anchorage; hours and entry prices not verified from a published source.
Real beach; Wikipedia (Miramar article) confirms it as the other beach in Panjim. Coordinates approximate for the Caranzalem coast; not point-verified.

Coordinates (15.498565, 73.826663) and hours from a business directory listing; fish-thali reputation from LBB. NOTE: ritzclassic.com fetched but the domain is now hijacked (spam 'Advanced Resins' content) — website dropped, set to null.

Coordinates (15.49666, 73.826998) from a business directory listing; concept/details from Food Lovers TV and Tripopola. koknikanteen.in failed to load on fetch — website set to null rather than guessing it works.

Address, phone, hours and concept from Evendo/Trip.com/Tripadvisor listings; price range from published TripAdvisor listing. Coordinates approximate for Martins Building on D.B. Marg, Miramar; not point-verified. No fetch-verified official website found.
Official website fetched and confirmed live (Viva Panjim, family restaurant in a heritage home, with matching address, hours and menu). Coordinates (15.496498, 73.83131) from a directory listing.

Official website fetched and confirmed live; the Panjim address is listed on its own site's contact section. Coordinates approximate for Campal area; not point-verified. Hours from third-party listings.

Chapel and viewpoint confirmed via reviews/listings (top-rated.online, Justdial). Coordinates approximate from Padre Miranda Rd, Monte Hill, within 1km.
Market confirmed across travel guides; hours from toptouristplaces.in. Coordinates approximate from Gandhi Market area, within 1km.
Garden confirmed via mark-horner.com (Wikipedia-sourced Margao article) and TripAdvisor. Coordinates approximate, within 1km of town centre.
Beach confirmed by multiple guides; coordinates are the well-established Colva Beach location, well within 1km.
Beach confirmed by multiple travel guides; coordinates are the established Benaulim Beach location.
Beach confirmed by travel guides; coordinates approximate from the Colva-Sernabatim shoreline, within 1km.

Coordinates from tripopola.com (15.264864, 73.941477). Hours and fee from holidaylandmark.com and tripxl.com; sources agree on timings, fee sources concur within Rs 100-300 range.
Stadium confirmed by Expedia guide and Ravindra Bhavan listings ('near Fatorda Stadium'); coordinates approximate from Fatorda locality, within 1km.
Coordinates from meta.ai listing (15.285389, 73.962951). Official site (ravindrabhavanmargao.com) appeared in search but was not fetched for verification, so not listed.
Coordinates from meta.ai listing (15.273416, 73.958933). Official website fetched and confirmed live: official parish site with matching address/phone.
Coordinates from meta.ai listing (15.277746, 73.959409). Hours from listings are inconsistent (weekend-only evening slots), so hours left null.
Mansion confirmed via newkerala and Tripadvisor listing. Coordinates approximate from Pajifond (near Ana Fonte Garden), within 1km.
Neighbourhood confirmed via Gomantak Times video guide and Margao history sources. Coordinates approximate from Comba ward, within 1km.

Mansion confirmed via Outlook Traveller (built 1590, near Big Foot). Coordinates approximate from Loutolim village, within 1km.
Coordinates from meta.ai listing (15.271978, 73.957679). Hours and price-for-two from Justdial listing (crawled recently). No official website found to verify.
Coordinates from meta.ai listing (15.303789, 73.914293). Hours from trip.com/eazydiner listings; official site (martinscornergoa.com) appeared in search but was not fetched, so not listed.
Address and hours from restaurant-guru and Tripadvisor. Coordinates approximate from Valaulikar Rd opposite Municipal Garden, within 1km.
Coordinates from meta.ai listing (15.271533, 73.96711); recommended by Outlook Traveller's Margao guide. Hours from business listing.

Coordinates from meta.ai listing (15.287511, 73.955012); hours/price from Justdial. navtara.in is the chain's official domain (cited across listings) but the fetch returned only a bot-verification interstitial, so site content could not be confirmed.
Existence and hours from Wanderlog; recommended in Outlook Traveller's Margao food guide. Coordinates approximate from market/Pajifond area, within 1km.

Beach is widely documented (Tripadvisor 4.1, 300 reviews). Geocoder matched 'Bimbel Beach' adjacent to Bogmalo at 15.37352, 73.82113; Bogmalo's main bay is within a few hundred metres, so coords are approximate.

Verified via location page found in web search (described as 'beneath Japanese garden', 4.8 rating) at 15.404982, 73.786575; consistent with garden coords just above it.
Verified via Tripadvisor (4.2 rating, 'one of the major attractions in Vasco') and exact geocode match: 'St Andrews Church, Vollant Main Road, Vasco da Gama' at 15.39963, 73.81735.
Verified via Justdial (4.0, 5,123 ratings) and the official Goa tourism listing bainabeach.goa.gov.in (place_id page, coords 15.391586, 73.806801).
Verified via Justdial (4.0, 207 ratings) and exact geocode match: 'Hansa Beach, Vasco da Gama' at 15.37696, 73.8134.
Verified via Tripadvisor (4.2 rating, described as less visited) and location page found in web search giving exact location 15.354521, 73.884069 (Consua/Salcete, ~3.7 miles from Dabolim airport).

Verified via Justdial listing (5.0, 1 rating) as a tourist attraction. Geocoder returned sub-district 'Velsao-Issorcim' centroid 15.37925, 73.85054; the beach on the coast is roughly 0.5 km west, so coords are approximate.

Verified via Tripadvisor listing ('Shree Damodar Temple, near Vaddem') and exact geocode match: 'Shri Damodar Temple, New Vaddem Road, Vaddem' at 15.39886, 73.82533. Role in Vasco Saptah verified via itsgoa.com and Wikipedia.

Verified via multiple Tripadvisor reviews describing it as the Mormugao port viewpoint with benches and steel rails, ~500 m walk from Mormugao Fort. Geocode match 'Pilot Point, F L Gomes Road' at 15.39798, 73.81127.

Departure jetties are around Vasco/Sancoale/Coco Jetty.

Verified via mapcarta/OSM data (coords 15.4061, 73.8635; inhabited island in Zuari estuary) and Wikipedia (church of St Hyacinth, defunct lighthouse). Note: Wikipedia cites reports that outsider visits are discouraged by residents — visit respectfully.

Verified via Tripadvisor (4.8, 456 reviews) and location page (office address, phone +91 94220 56037). Caveat: the page also carried unrelated third-party casino/spam links (likely SEO spam injection), so link to it with caution.
